name: li-human
title_zh: 发帖前先过五道检测关的AI痕迹清除器
tagline_zh: 删掉em dash和AI口水词还不够，连隐形水印字符都揪出来。发LinkedIn前先跑一遍。
tagline_en: Strips em dashes, slop words, even invisible watermark chars. Run any draft through 5 detection checks before it.
desc_en: Strip the machine fingerprint out of any draft - em dashes, AI slop words, invisible watermark characters - and score it against a five-check detection panel before it goes out. Use whenever text needs to sound human, when the user says humanize, "does this sound like AI", "remove the em dashes", "de-slop this", "will this get flagged", or before any LinkedIn post, comment, reply or DM is shown to
why_zh: 不是简单替换同义词，而是用五重检测面板逐项扫描，连肉眼看不见的Unicode水印字符都不放过。
why_en: Not synonym swapping—it scans on five axes and digs out invisible Unicode watermarks, erasing machine fingerprints at the.
limit_zh: 只处理文本草稿，不生成新内容；检测面板固定五项，不覆盖图片、视频或语音；需要联网调用检测服务，离线环境无法运行。
limit_en: Text drafts only, no content generation. Fixed 5-check panel; no image/audio/video. Needs network for detection services; offline won't work.
title_en: AI-trace remover with a 5-check panel before you post
